none: PAS FindID 635524: Possibly Early Medieval lead weight
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Lead possible weight. Cast oval slightly concavo-convex object. The concave face bears an incised T or a cross; the finder kindly notes the similarity of this figure to the runic letter Tiw . Heavily patinated overall. The mass could suggest this to represent three Scandinavian units of 4.07gms or one half ora / ore . Though the appearance of this module in uneven multiples is uncommon, another…
